message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are present; data is consumed directly from numpy/pandas without any validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads data from local paths/datasets only; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks for label-flipping anomalies, validates label distributions, or uses label-noise detection tools like Cleanlab anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training samples before use.

No detected model integrity verification: The code saves model weights with torch.save() but never loads pretrained weights, and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when saving or loading any model artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation clustering, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a standard PyTorch optimizer with no DP-SGD, Opacus, or TensorFlow Privacy integration.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (RMSE, Recall, AUC) are computed and a validation split exists via train_test_split, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation guarantee preventing data leakage, and no independent test set separate from the validation set used for model selection.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection are performed before data is passed to the model; tensors are forwarded directly after dataset construction.
No detected output bounds checks: The predict and validate functions return raw numpy arrays of predictions without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold enforcement.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models (RNNSM, RMTPP, Grobformer) are time-series/sequence models, not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
